description: Provision a Google Cloud Iam IAMCustomRole via Config Connector. Fields mirror the iam.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 IAMCustomRole spec.

description.description: A human-readable description for the role.

permissions.description: The names of the permissions this role grants when bound in an IAM policy. At least one permission must be specified.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The roleId of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

stage.description: The current launch stage of the role. Defaults to GA.

title.description: A human-readable title for the role.

title: GCP Iam IAMCustomRole
